title: Add a program (2½ minutes)
blurb: Put a new meeting or event on the website: title, description, date, time, place, photo, and Publish.

title: Change the words on a page (1½ minutes)
blurb: Open a page from the website, type a change, make words bold, and save.

title: Undo a change (1½ minutes)
blurb: Go back to an earlier version of a page with Revisions.
